thread:
Priya: FYI hitting a weird failure in DAST premerge for feature/edge-headers. The scanner can't fetch test creds - KMS decrypt returns 403 but audit shows a different principal. cc @Tom

Tom: can you paste the error?

Priya: sure. from pipeline logs:
```
2024-04-12T15:02:13Z ERROR DAST: decrypt error: PermissionDenied: Requested 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt' for principal serviceAccount:dast-runner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

Priya: but when I queried audit logs I see decrypts from `ci-pool@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com` around the same time, not the dast-runner SA.

Nina: that's odd. we recently changed the GH Actions runner auth to use Workload Identity Federation -> token-exchange, could the pipeline be impersonating a different SA?

Tom: possible. quick gcloud to check KMS audit entries:
```
gcloud logging read "resource.type=cloudkms_crypto_key AND protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt\" AND timestamp>\"2024-04-12T14:50:00Z\"" --limit 50 --format=json
```
This shows principalEmail and request metadata. Look for principalEmail fields.

Priya: ran that, here's the extracted line:
```
"protoPayload": {"authenticationInfo": {"principalEmail": "ci-pool@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"}, "request": {"name": "projects/.../cryptoKeyVersions/1", "additionalAuthenticatedData": "commit=abc123"}}
```
Commit metadata present but principal mismatch.

security-bot: note: SDLC-420 created to track CI auth drift and keystore access audit mismatch (owner @Tom).

Tom: I suspect a recent infra change swapped the runner identity mapping; the DAST step might request impersonation but the token exchange returned the Pool SA. We'll dig into GH Action `permissions` + OIDC subject mapping.

Nina: temporary mitigation: add an allowlist binding so ci-pool can decrypt for the test key, but only for the test key and only for 6 hours. I'll create a short-lived IAM binding via gcloud iam roles binding with condition.

Priya: please also add CI fallback: if decrypt fails, use local test vault secret (cached) and mark the scan as "soft-fail" with a comment linking SDLC-420 so release isn't blocked.

Tom: Agreed. I'll push a tiny GH Actions change to set SKIP_DAST_ON_DECRYPT_FAIL=true and post a comment on the PR.

infra-bot: policy-change: created temporary binding `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` for member `serviceAccount:ci-pool@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com` on key `projects/.../cryptoKeys/test-key` with expiration 2024-04-12T22:00:00Z (6h).

Priya: confirmed DAST resumed, run passed. Thanks.

Nina: next steps: (1) audit mapping between GH OIDC sub->SA (infra), (2) update keystore access matrix to include pool SA exceptions with conditional bindings (security), (3) make DAST resilient (soft-fail + cached secrets) (sast/dast owners). I've put these in SDLC-420 todo list.

Tom: I'll also add logging to the runner to include commit SHA and workflow run id in the KMS request AAD so we can trace in the future: set env var KMS_AAD=commit=${{ github.sha }}|run=${{ github.run_id }}

Priya: Perfect. Filing a 15-min postmortem note under SDLC-420 and tagging release manager. Closing here unless someone needs more info.

Nina: thanks everyone :handshake:
